stories.title: 16-year-old boy kills brother, sister-in-law, nephew in Gorakhpur:Murdered entire family while they slept; accused teen found hiding in room
stories.summary: A 16-year-old boy allegedly hacked his elder brother, sister-in-law and three-year-old nephew to death with a cleaver while they were asleep in Uttar Pradesh's Gorakhpur district. The family's nine-year-old adopted daughter reportedly witnessed the attack and ran from the room screaming. Her cries woke the grandparents, who rushed to investigate. When the father entered the room, he found the bodies of all three victims lying in pools of blood. The accused was reportedly emerging from the room carrying a bloodstained cleaver. Shocked by the scene, the father was unable to react immediately. The teenager then went upstairs and quietly sat in his room. After regaining composure, the father informed neighbours and the police. Senior police officials, including the SSP and SP, arrived at the scene with a police team. After inspecting the room, the father told officers that his younger son was responsible for the killings and was sitting upstairs. Police found the accused seated on the floor with the weapon still in his possession and took him into custody. The deceased have been identified as Amit Gupta, his wife Ranjana, and their three-year-old son Reyansh. The incident took place at around 3 am on Monday in the Bansgaon police station area, around 50 kilometres from the district headquarters. Police have not yet established a clear motive. However, preliminary investigations suggest an ongoing dispute over the family's grocery shop. Allegedly entered the room at 3 am and attacked repeatedly According to police, the family lived in a two-storey house. Amit, his wife and their two children occupied a room on the ground floor along with Amit's parents, while the younger brother lived upstairs. At around 3 am, the accused allegedly entered Amit's room while the family was asleep. Investigators say he launched a sudden attack with a cleaver, repeatedly striking his elder brother, sister-in-law and nephew as they slept. None of the victims had an opportunity to defend themselves. All three died at the scene. Father left, terrified by bloodstained son When father Harilal Gupta entered the room, he found blood splattered across the floor and walls. The accused was reportedly leaving the room with the weapon still in his hand. Harilal later told police that he was terrified by what he saw and did not confront his son. The teenager then went directly to his room upstairs, where police later detained him. Dispute over family shop emerges as possible motive Police have learned that the Gupta family owns a grocery shop in a nearby market. The younger son had been managing the business, while Amit had been working away from home. However, Amit returned to the village a few months ago and began spending more time at the shop. According to investigators, the younger brother allegedly believed Amit intended to take control of the business, leading to frequent disputes within the family. Police are continuing to investigate the circumstances surrounding the killings. Police statement Superintendent of Police Dinesh Puri said- Amit, Ranjana and Reyansh were sleeping in the same room. All three were killed there. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem examination. The accused brother is being questioned. Adopted daughter witnessed the attack Amit Gupta married Ranjana around 15 years ago. The couple were unable to have children for several years and eventually adopted a daughter, who is now nine years old. Three years ago, they had a son, Reyansh. According to police, the accused killed Amit, Ranjana and Reyansh but did not attack the adopted daughter. The child later told family members that she saw her uncle attack her father first before turning on her mother and younger brother. She said she ran from the room screaming and informed her grandmother. The girl reportedly told investigators that she repeatedly pleaded with her uncle not to harm her brother, but he continued the attack. Previous family disputes and alleged demand for money Harilal Gupta has submitted a formal complaint to police. According to his statement, Amit had worked outside the village before returning around two years ago and becoming involved in the family shop. This reportedly led to resentment from the younger son. Harilal alleged that the accused first struck the victims on the head with a stick before using a sharp-edged weapon to inflict fatal neck injuries. Police said the teenager studied up to Class 9. Harilal is a heart patient and uses a urinary catheter, while his wife is also undergoing medical treatment. The family reported that there had been previous disputes involving the accused. Around two months ago, he allegedly demanded ₹5 lakh from his father to start work or a business venture. The disagreement was later settled at a police station. Family members also alleged that the teenager frequently consumed alcohol and regularly created disturbances at home. Amit had previously worked as a painter and polisher outside the village before returning home approximately two years ago.

stories.title: Family is stunned as son returns alive after funeral:Mother breaks down crying; body is wrongly identified
stories.summary: In Ghaziabad, a young man returned home at 5 AM on Thursday, the very next day after his thirteenth-day ritual (terahvin). When he knocked on the door, his mother saw her son and embraced him. Then the mother started crying inconsolably, saying, "Son, where were you? We even performed your thirteenth-day ritual." Family members asked him about being missing for about a month. However, due to his mental instability, he could not explain anything. According to the police, the young man was sent to jail on May 16 on charges of disturbing the peace after a fight with local shopkeepers. Since then, he had not been found. The case belongs to the Kaushambi police station area. See 2 pictures Now the full story in detail... Girdhar Singh Bisht lives with his mother in Kalpana Apartment, located in Vaishali. His father had already passed away. According to his family, Girdhar is mentally unwell, which is why he is not married. On May 16, he had an argument with nearby shopkeepers over some issue. After the commotion, the police arrested him on charges of disturbing the peace and sent him to jail. Did not return home even after bail On May 21, Girdhar was granted bail by the court. He was also released from Dasna Jail that same evening, but he did not return home. According to his family, no family member went to the jail to pick him up. After extensive searching, when he could not be found, a missing person report was filed. Meanwhile, on June 13, an unidentified body was found in the Ganga Canal in the Mussoorie police station area. Police called the family members for identification. The family identified the body as Girdhar. After this, the family members and local residents reached Kaushambi police station. They protested, questioning the role of the police and jail administration. Upon receiving information, Indirapuram ACP Abhishek Srivastava reached the spot and pacified the people by assuring an impartial investigation. Youth returned after cremation After the post-mortem, the police handed over the body to the family. The family had also performed his last rites. The thirteenth-day ritual was performed on June 24. Relatives and neighbors also attended it. But, on the morning of June 25, around 5 AM, Girdhar suddenly returned home. Mother said - Who was the one whose thirteenth-day ritual we performed? Girdhar's mother said - My husband had already passed away. I also have cancer. When my son returned home this morning, we were all surprised. We had just performed his thirteenth-day ritual yesterday. I am happy that my son has returned. But now the question that is bothering me is, who was the one whose last rites were performed? We also had some doubts about the identity. Now the police should investigate and tell us whose body it was? SHO said - Youth's mental condition is not good Mussoorie Police Station in-charge Harendra Malik said that the youth is being interrogated. His mental condition does not seem normal. He sometimes identifies himself as an intelligence officer, and sometimes reveals his identity by taking the name of some VIP. He said that the post-mortem report of the body, which was identified by the family as Girdhar, found the cause of death to be drowning. Now the entire matter will be re-investigated.

stories.title: Congress appoints Rajendra Pal as UP in-charge:Avinash Pandey is removed; Ajay Rai faces uncertainty
stories.summary: Congress removed UP in-charge Avinash Pandey from his post on Friday evening. In his place, Rajendra Pal Gautam has been made the UP in-charge. On May 19, he had suddenly reached to meet BSP chief Mayawati along with Barabanki MP Tanuj Punia without an appointment. Thus, he had to return without meeting her. Rajendra Pal has been a minister in Arvind Kejriwal's government in Delhi. He had left the Aam Aadmi Party and joined Congress in September 2024. Sources claim that the party may soon remove Congress state president Ajay Rai from his post as well. Keeping in mind the 2027 assembly elections, Congress may hand over the reins of UP to an OBC (Other Backward Class) or Muslim face. Imran Masood and Rakesh Rathore in the race for UP president According to sources, Congress MPs from UP had met the high command in Delhi recently. During this, the MPs had demanded that either Imran Masood or Rakesh Rathore be made the UP president. Imran Masood is an MP from Saharanpur seat in West UP. He is a prominent Muslim leader from West UP. By making him president, the party wants to keep the Muslim vote bank completely on its side. Meanwhile, Rakesh Rathore is an MP from Sitapur. He is a prominent leader from the OBC category. By giving him responsibility, Rahul Gandhi's 'backward politics' and the narrative of caste census can be strengthened on the ground. Ajay Rai, UP President for 3 years Ajay Rai was appointed as the President of UP Congress on August 17, 2023, replacing Brijlal Khabri. His 3-year tenure will be completed in the upcoming August. Ajay Rai is considered a very active leader. He gave a tough fight to Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the Varanasi seat in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, which significantly increased his political stature. Ajay Rai comes from the Bhumihar community, whose population in UP is very small. Also, the Bhumihar vote bank is considered to be in favor of BJP. In such a situation, to balance the caste equations for the 2027 assembly elections, the command of UP Congress can be handed over to a minority or OBC face. Efforts to achieve social engineering According to party sources, the decision to reshuffle the UP Congress was taken to rectify caste equations in the upcoming assembly elections. Currently, both the state president Ajay Rai and in-charge Avinash Pandey belong to the upper caste. Whereas Rahul Gandhi is continuously raising the issue of caste census and 'the greater the population, the greater the share'. In such a situation, having upper castes in both top positions in a politically sensitive state like UP was not conducive to the party's strategy. To fight the 2027 battle strongly, Congress now wants to attract the Dalits of the state by bringing a Dalit face as the UP in-charge. Rajendra came into Rahul's notice from the Kanshiram Jayanti program This time, Congress celebrated Kanshiram Jayanti (March 13) as 'Social Change Day'. The party organized a big event in Lucknow on this day. Rahul Gandhi was the chief guest there. Rajendra Pal Gautam was behind that event. Since then, he had come into Rahul Gandhi's notice. Rahul praised Rajendra from the stage, saying that he had not only highlighted the problem but also suggested a solution. Now, Rajendra's appointment as the state in-charge is being linked to this very sequence of events. Waited for 10 minutes, wrote down mobile number and returned A meeting of the Congress Scheduled Caste Department was held at the Congress headquarters in Lucknow on May 19. After this, the department's national president Rajendra Pal Gautam, Congress MP from Barabanki Tanuj Punia, and other leaders suddenly reached Mayawati's house. At the gate, through the security guard, they called Mayawati's private secretary Mewalal Gautam and asked for time to meet Mayawati. According to sources, the Congress leaders kept waiting at the gate for about 10 minutes. Then a message came from inside that Behanji (Mayawati) is busy, and the meeting will not be possible right now. After this, the Congress leaders wrote down their names and mobile numbers at the gate and returned. Its pictures had gone viral. At that time, its political implications began to be drawn. News spread that Congress, leaving SP, was exploring possibilities of an alliance with BSP in the UP assembly elections. On May 19, Rahul Gandhi was also in Raebareli. In such a situation, it was directly claimed that these leaders wanted to meet Mayawati with a message from him. Congress had to do damage control After returning empty-handed from Mayawati's house, Congress had to do damage control. UP Congress President Ajay Rai clarified on May 20, saying - "This was a personal program of those leaders. No official order was given by the party." Meanwhile, Rajendra Pal Gautam had said that Mayawati is a former Chief Minister of the Dalit community. Therefore, he had gone to meet her to inquire about her well-being. Barabanki MP Tanuj Punia also called it a 'general visit'. He had said that "Behanji is a senior leader of our community. She has turned 70 years old. We had gone to inquire about her health."

stories.title: Pool day takes a wild turn with surprise visitor:Snake enters swimmer's underwear; friends keep their cool during rescue
stories.summary: A dramatic video from Uttar Pradesh's Auraiya district has gone viral on social media after showing a shocking incident involving a swimmer and a snake. The clip, which has been viewed millions of times, shows the tense moment when a young man reportedly realised that a snake had slipped inside his underwear while he was bathing in a swimming pool. The unexpected incident created panic among people at the pool, as the swimmer's friends rushed to help him without putting anyone in danger. Friends quickly help remove the snake The viral video shows the young man standing in the pool in visible panic while his friends carefully checked the situation. To avoid touching the snake directly, one friend carefully held the waistband of the underwear while the swimmer stepped out of it and quickly wrapped himself in a towel. Reportedly a non-venomous water snake According to reports shared with the video, the reptile was believed to be a water snake. These snakes are generally non-venomous and are commonly found near ponds, lakes, canals and other freshwater bodies. Although they are usually harmless, their sudden appearance can easily frighten people because they look similar to venomous snakes. Fortunately, no one was injured in the incident, and the swimmer escaped unharmed despite the terrifying experience.

stories.title: Woman cop caught on camera kissing constable at police station:Jalaun SP suspends both after affair comes to light
stories.summary: Jalaun SP Vinay Kumar Singh suspended constable Arvind Patel, posted at Orai Kotwali, on Thursday. Arvind's only fault was that a female constable kissed him on Wednesday night. Arvind is having an affair with the female constable. Both work together. These private moments between the two were captured on CCTV installed in the control room. In which the female constable is seen kissing Arvind, who is sitting on a chair. Arvind was also seen trying to distance himself from the female constable by getting up from the chair. After the CCTV footage came to light, the SP suspended Arvind Patel. While an investigation has also been launched against the female constable. See 2 pictures Now understand the whole matter Arvind Patel, a resident of Prayagraj Arvind Patel, a resident of Prayagraj, is a constable of the 2018 batch. He is posted at Orai Kotwali. Arvind has been assigned the work of a clerk (Munshi). On Wednesday night, Arvind was on night shift duty. He was working on the computer in the control room. Just then, a trainee female constable in civil dress entered the control room. As soon as she entered, she grabbed Arvind, who was sitting on the chair, from behind. After this, she suddenly started kissing him. When the clerk started to leave, she stopped him and repeated the act In the 2-minute video, it can be seen that after this act of the female constable, when Arvind left his work and got up from the chair to leave, the woman stopped him by talking to him. After this, the clerk takes out a register from between files, places it on top, and tries to work on the computer again. During this, the constable again comes near him and repeats the same act. Meanwhile, the female constable heard someone approaching, so she went towards the gate. She didn't see anyone outside, so she returned to Arvind in the control room. During this, Arvind started putting away files. Then the woman came to the clerk in the control room and sat on a chair. Munshi suspended, inquiry set up against trainee constable When the video of both of them's actions during duty inside the control room reached the officers, it created a stir in the department. Considering the seriousness of the matter, SP Vinay Kumar Singh immediately ordered an investigation. During the preliminary investigation, Munshi Arvind Patel has been suspended. Along with this, an inquiry has also been set up against the female trainee constable. Orders have been given for a detailed departmental inquiry into the entire incident. SP said - Such behavior on duty will not be tolerated SP Vinay Kumar Singh says- Discipline is paramount in the police department. Any kind of indiscipline or complaint related to conduct during duty will be taken seriously. Strict action will also be taken against the trainee constable based on the investigation report.

stories.title: No SpiceJet flights from Varanasi now:Surge in cost of aviation fuel hits operations
stories.summary: All regular SpiceJet flights from Varanasi have been suspended. The airline has stopped its operations from Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport for an indefinite period due to rising operating costs and the continuous increase in Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices. SpiceJet, which was operating 14-15 flights from Varanasi, flew its last regular flight on Thursday evening. The airline had already announced that June 25 would be its final day of scheduled operations from the airport. All its aircraft have now been shifted to hangars in Delhi and Mumbai. Rising airfares have also reduced passenger numbers, and attention is now on the services and decisions of other airlines operating from Varanasi. SG-506 was the last flight On Thursday evening, SpiceJet's last flight (SG-506) to Mumbai departed from Varanasi. With this, all regular flight services of the airline from Varanasi ceased from Friday. Previously, SpiceJet was operating flights to several major cities including Delhi, Mumbai, and Pune. Currently, flights from Varanasi Airport by IndiGo, Air India, and Akasa Air are operating to Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and other cities. However, the sharp increase in ATF prices over the last two months has significantly raised the operating costs for airlines, which is impacting flight operations. 12 flights from Varanasi have already been suspended The impact of rising operating costs is not limited to SpiceJet alone. IndiGo, Air India Express, Akasa Air, and other airlines have also suspended operations of several flights from Varanasi. So far, about 12 incoming and outgoing flights have been affected. Indigo has cancelled one flight each for Hyderabad and Bengaluru. Air India Express has stopped operating one flight each on its Mumbai and Bengaluru routes. SpiceJet had already cancelled flights to Delhi and Pune, and now its Mumbai service has also been terminated. Meanwhile, Akasa Air is going to cancel three of its flights to Bengaluru starting next month. Additionally, Air India has also cancelled the operation of some of its scheduled flights. With continuously decreasing flights, air travel options from Varanasi are becoming limited. Passengers to face increased burden With SpiceJet completely withdrawing and other flights being cancelled, passengers travelling from Varanasi to Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and other metropolitan cities may face increased difficulties. The decrease in the number of flights will increase pressure on available seats, which is also expected to lead to an increase in airfares. Getting tickets can become even more difficult during festivals and holidays. Due to increased ATF prices, many routes are no longer economically profitable for airlines. For this reason, companies are reviewing their networks and reducing flights on routes with low demand.

stories.title: 4 members of same family die in UP road crash:Haryana number Fortuner collides with another car on way to Haridwar
stories.summary: A Haryana-registered Fortuner car met with an accident in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh. A speeding WagonR hit the Fortuner from behind with great force. In the accident, four members of the same family traveling in the Fortuner died, while three others were seriously injured. All the occupants of the Fortuner are said to be residents of Sonipat. They were going to Haridwar for darshan. Among the deceased are two women, an elderly person, and a child. The injured are undergoing treatment in the hospital. The incident occurred on Friday evening around 4:30 PM on the Dehradun-Panchkula Highway in the Rampur Maniharan police station area. Upon receiving information, the police reached the spot and took the injured to the hospital. The police have registered a case and started investigating the causes of the accident.

stories.title: Bike rider saves 26 lives after AC bus catches fire:Passengers jump from windows and doors; smoke seen 2 km away
stories.summary: A double-decker AC bus caught fire at 7 AM on Friday in Meerut, UP. Passengers saved their lives by jumping out of windows and doors. The fire was so fierce that a plume of smoke was visible from 2 km away. Nearby residents tried to extinguish the fire but failed. The fire brigade was called, but by then the bus was almost completely burnt. The accident occurred near Dadri flyover in Daurala police station area on the Delhi-Dehradun Highway. The bus, carrying 26 passengers, was traveling from Jaipur to Haridwar. Passengers were sent to Haridwar by another bus. According to the police, a motorcyclist coming from behind overtook the bus and informed the driver about smoke rising from it. The driver immediately pulled the bus to the side of the road. All passengers quickly disembarked from the bus. After this, the bus caught fire. The bus was reduced to ashes in 20-25 minutes. See 3 pictures CFO said - The fire was brought under control in one and a half to two hours CFO Surendra Singh said - Upon receiving information about the fire in the morning, the vehicle was dispatched around 7:30 AM. The bus caught fire on the border of Muzaffarnagar and Meerut. The vehicle arrived on time. The fire was brought under control in one and a half to two hours. One fire engine was called from Sardhana, two from Meerut, and one from Muzaffarnagar. Daurala Inspector Suman Kumar Singh said - Information was received about a fire in a Rajasthan Roadways bus. A police team arrived upon receiving the information. All passengers are safe in the accident and have been sent to Haridwar by another bus.

stories.title: Allahabad high court says delaying panchayat polls is wrong:Government faces contempt remark, affidavit ordered
stories.summary: Allahabad High Court expresses strong displeasure over delay in UP panchayat elections The Allahabad High Court on Friday expressed strong displeasure over the delay in holding panchayat elections in Uttar Pradesh. earing a petition challenging the appointment of village heads as administrators, the bench of Justice Siddharth Nandan asked the state government, "How did you appoint village heads as administrators?" The court observed that the move violates the Division Bench's order and falls within the category of contempt of court. The next hearing is scheduled for 13 July. The High Court also said that if the state government fails to give a satisfactory reply by then, the concerned official will have to appear in person. Election Commission says it is ready to hold polls During the hearing, the State Election Commission told the court that the voters' list had already been published on 10 June 2026 and that it is ready to conduct the elections. However, the poll process has been stalled because the state government has not provided the necessary arrangements. First, know what the High Court said on March 17 ‘Why are Panchayat elections not being conducted within the stipulated timeframe? Will the election process be completed within the constitutional timeframe or not?’ This question was asked by the Allahabad High Court to the UP State Election Commission. The court has asked the commission to clarify the status of preparations for the Gram Panchayat elections-2026. Actually, the matter of postponing Panchayat elections in UP is in the Allahabad High Court. On March 17, a petition filed by petitioner Imtiaz Hussain was heard. It demanded that a detailed and time-bound program for the entire process of Panchayat elections be presented before the court before the expiry of the District Panchayat's term. The case was heard by a division bench of Justice Atul Sreedharan and Justice Siddharth Nandan. State Government's Responsibility Stated Petitioner Imtiaz Hussain argued in court that according to Article 243E of the Constitution, the term of a Panchayat can be a maximum of 5 years from the date of its first meeting, and no more. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct elections on time. Meanwhile, the State Election Commission argued that according to Section 12-BB of the UP Panchayat Raj Act 1947, it is the responsibility of the state government to issue a notification fixing the date for general elections or by-elections of the Pradhan. This notification is issued in consultation with the State Election Commission. Clarification sought from the Commission After hearing all sides, the High Court has asked the State Election Commission whether it is in a position to conduct the Panchayat elections according to the existing notification of February 19, 2026? The court also said that the Panchayat elections should be completed by or before May 26, 2026. Term will end on May 2 Panchayat elections were held in UP in 2021. Based on this, the term of Gram Pradhans, Gram Panchayat members, Kshetra Panchayat members, and Zila Panchayat members will end on May 2. This is why the Panchayat elections are proposed to be held from April to June 2026. Two reasons for delay in Panchayat elections The work of voter list revision (SIR) for the Panchayat elections will also be completed on March 27. On the same day, the final publication of the voter lists will be done. The government and the State Election Commission were preparing to conduct the Panchayat elections in April-May itself. But now a large administrative, teacher, and employee staff of the state will be engaged in the house listing work for the census. According to BJP sources, the house listing work will continue till September. Before that, the party will start preparations for the 2027 assembly elections. In such a situation, all political parties, including the SP, are also not in favor of holding panchayat elections after September. Government and organization also do not want elections on time BJP sources say that the party and the government are also not in favor of holding elections on time. There are several political risks in panchayat elections before the assembly elections. Firstly, political rivalries will increase among party workers in the villages. Secondly, party workers, unhappy with the non-selection of candidates, might take tickets from other parties and weaken the party. If the party's performance is not good in the elections for District Panchayat members and Area Panchayat members, it will directly affect the assembly elections. Even in 2021, the experience of the first phase of the Panchayat elections was not good for the Yogi government and the BJP. They had to struggle a lot to control the damage. Panchayati Raj Department is not prepared The State Election Commission had written a letter to the Panchayati Raj Department asking them to determine the reservation for the Panchayat elections and submit the list. The Panchayati Raj Department has to form a committee to determine the reservation. The committee will determine the reservation for 2026 based on the Panchayat reservations of 2021 and 2015. The process of determining reservation takes about 2 months, but the department has not yet even started the exercise of forming a committee. High-ranking officials of the department have also indicated that there are currently no preparations for the Panchayat elections. No indication has been received from the high level in the government for this either.

stories.title: 'Those who tamper with Sanatan faith won't be spared':Yogi Adityanath after 8 arrests in Ram Mandir fund theft case
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath reacted to the arrest of eight people, including Tinnu Yadav, in the alleged Ram Temple offering theft case. Addressing a public gathering in Deoria on Friday, he said action had begun after the Special Investigation Team (SIT) submitted its report. "We will separate the truth from the lies. Tampering with public faith is unacceptable. We will not spare anyone," he said. The Chief Minister urged people not to malign Ayodhya without evidence. "If you have proof, submit it to the SIT. Otherwise, stop spreading such allegations. Do not test the faith of Lord Ram's devotees. We will not tolerate any attempt to undermine their faith," he said. Yogi also remarked- Remember, the Congress not only looted the country but also divided it. Those who ordered firing on people for chanting Lord Ram's name are today claiming that faith has been tampered with. Will they lecture us on faith? He also took a swipe at former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal's visit to Ayodhya. 'A gentleman has also arrived from Delhi. Let me tell him that he gave Delhi nothing in 15 years. He should visit Ayodhya and then reflect. Had he worked in Delhi the way we have worked in Ayodhya, Delhi too would have been shining,' Yogi said. Earlier in the day, the Chief Minister laid the foundation stone and inaugurated 106 development projects worth ₹456.38 crore. Key highlights from Yogi's speech in Deoria 1. Those questioning Ram once ordered firing on devotees Yogi said those now questioning issues related to Lord Ram were the same people who had earlier denied His existence. "There was one side that claimed Lord Ram did not exist. They continued protesting and fought the matter all the way to the Supreme Court with an army of lawyers. The same people who once ordered firing on Ram devotees are now claiming that faith has been tampered with." 2. The Uncle-Nephew duo used to auction government jobs Targeting the Samajwadi Party, Yogi said its previous government was known for corruption in recruitment. "Everyone knows how the SP government functioned. The entire family was involved in extorting money in exchange for jobs. Today, young people from Deoria are securing jobs through police recruitment. Had there not been a double-engine government, these youths would have been deprived of employment. Under the uncle-nephew duo, government jobs would simply have been auctioned." 3. 'We stopped a ₹3,000-crore scam in the Purvanchal Expressway project' The Chief Minister claimed the previous SP government had floated the tender for the Purvanchal Expressway in 2016 despite land not having been acquired. "The proposed expressway was to be 340 km long and 110 metres wide, with an estimated cost of ₹15,800 crore. When our government came to power, I asked about the project's progress and found that land acquisition had not even begun. I questioned how the tender had been floated without acquiring the land." He said his government first completed the land acquisition process and widened the proposed expressway from 110 metres to 120 metres to allow for future expansion, including the possibility of a high-speed rail corridor. Yogi further claimed that after re-tendering the project in 2018, the bids remained at ₹15,800 crore. That tender was also cancelled, and a third tender was issued with simplified conditions and simultaneous technical and financial bidding. "The project was eventually completed for ₹11,200 crore. A robbery of nearly ₹3,000 crore was being attempted, and we stopped it. Since the SP could no longer benefit, it is now trying to defame Ayodhya Dham." 4. 'It's Muharram, yet there is no trace of any goon' Highlighting his government's law-and-order record, Yogi said- "I had promised a policy of zero tolerance. Congress and the SP had turned Uttar Pradesh into a state dominated by the mafia. Even police stations were looted. Today, it is Muharram, yet there is no trace of any goon. No one dares create trouble. If anyone does, they will face consequences for generations." 5. 'SP, BSP and Congress looted under the cover of darkness' Yogi accused previous governments of deliberately failing to provide reliable electricity. "The SP, BSP and Congress did not ensure electricity because darkness suited them. That was when they carried out their loot. Today, I performed the Annaprashan ceremony for two children here. They were smiling because they know the double-engine government is working for them. These children are free from encephalitis. Our daughters no longer have to walk barefoot to school. They now have shoes and slippers." 6. Agricultural production has increased by 10 percentage points The Chief Minister said the double-engine government had improved infrastructure and boosted investment across Uttar Pradesh. "We have connected eastern and western Uttar Pradesh with better roads and are now accelerating north-south connectivity. Development will reach every doorstep. Better connectivity means faster development." He said the government had linked 6.5 million young people with investment opportunities across the state, which would help drive the growth of both Uttar Pradesh and India. Praising Agriculture Minister Surya Pratap Shahi, Yogi added- 'Our Agriculture Minister has worked to strengthen the sector. Agricultural production in Uttar Pradesh has increased from 8 per cent to 18 per cent.'

stories.title: Man molests minor after befriending her on Instagram:Accused threatens to kill entire family of the victim; FIR filed
stories.summary: Aryan Nishad, a resident of Gurugram, molested a 17-year-old girl and threatened to kill the minor's entire family, according to a police complaint filed on Thursday. Shahpur Police has filed an FIR based on the complaint. The victim's father alleged that the accused befriended his daughter on Instagram and took her to Gurugram. There, Nishad kept the girl at his home for four days and had physical relations with her. The full details of the case The father of the minor girl said Nishad befriended his daughter through Instagram. They talked for a few days. During this time, Aryan lured the girl and took her to his home in Dhanwapur, Gurugram. On 29 January 2026, a complaint was filed at Shahpur Police Station in this regard, and an FIR was registered. Subsequently, the police team started searching for the minor girl. Shahpur Police found the girl in Aryan's house in Gurugram on February 4. After this, the girl was kept at the One Stop Center of BRD Medical College. The father alleged that during this time, the investigating officer of the case told his daughter that whatever statement the female constable is writing, she must say the same thing in court. "I guarantee that Aryan and his mother will never bother your family again," the police told the girl, according to her father. By confusing her with words, the part about physical relations was removed from the daughter's statement, whereas she had been physically exploited for four days. Accused posted objectionable photos of elder daughter The father alleged that due to the investigator's negligence, Aryan's audacity increased. “He changed my daughter's Instagram account password and hacked it. Now he is sharing objectionable photos of my elder daughter on Instagram. He threatened my elder daughter, saying, ‘Tell your younger sister to turn on her mobile, otherwise I will kill the entire family’. Since then, the entire family has been scared and terrified.” The minor girl's father has also sent a petition to the SSP, CM Portal, and State Women's Commission. In this regard, Shahpur Police Station in-charge Rakesh Roshan Singh said that an FIR has been registered based on the complaint of the teenager's father. Further investigation is underway.

stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is witnessing tight security and large-scale Muharram processions on Friday, with authorities remaining on high alert as lakhs of devotees gather to commemorate the martyrdom of Hazrat Imam Hussain. Police are deploying drones, CCTV surveillance and heavy security along procession routes, particularly in sensitive districts, to ensure peaceful observance of the day. Two people have died in separate electrocution incidents during Muharram processions in Etah and Prayagraj. In Etah, a tazia reportedly comes in contact with a high-tension power line, killing one participant and seriously injuring seven others. Hours later, a 17-year-old boy dies after allegedly receiving an electric shock from a live power pole during a procession in Prayagraj. A fresh controversy is also unfolding in Firozabad after a video shows Additional Superintendent of Police Anuj Chaudhary measuring tazias with a tape measure before the procession. The video triggers sharp reactions from religious leaders, with All India Shia Personal Law Board General Secretary Maulana Yasoob Abbas accusing the officer of hurting religious sentiments and demanding his immediate suspension. Meanwhile, Muharram processions are continuing across the state amid elaborate security arrangements. In Lucknow, more than two lakh mourners are expected to join the main procession from the Imambara to Karbala Talkatora. Devotees dressed in black are participating in traditional mourning rituals, while processions in other districts are also drawing large crowds. Authorities are maintaining strict vigil throughout the day to ensure the events conclude peacefully. Track live updates on Muharram processions and developments from across Uttar Pradesh here…

stories.title: Criminal who snatched woman constable's chain killed in encounter:Fired shot with carbine at Shamli police, shot dead after 12 km chase
stories.summary: A wanted criminal in Shamli district of Uttar Pradesh, carrying a ₹50,000 reward, identified as Mehtab, was killed in a police encounter at around 5 am on Friday. The accused was reportedly fleeing after snatching a mobile phone from a farmer when he was intercepted by police. The police pursued him for nearly 12 kilometres before surrounding him. According to officials, the accused opened fire with a carbine after finding himself cornered. He was killed in retaliatory firing by the police. The encounter took place on the Delhi–Saharanpur Highway under the Kandhla police station area. The deceased, Mehtab alias Bechain, was an active member of the Mukim Kala gang and had 34 criminal cases registered against him. On 1 March, he had allegedly robbed a woman constable of her earrings and chain at gunpoint in Shamli. He was also involved in a robbery case targeting a sugar mill official. Superintendent of Police NP Singh said that following information about the robbery involving a farmer, police immediately cordoned off the area. In the exchange of fire, Mehtab was injured and later died during treatment. His accomplice managed to escape, and a search operation is underway. Legal proceedings are continuing. See 4 photos related to the encounter- Step-by-step account of the incident According to police, the incident began around 3 am on Friday when Narendra and his brother Nareshpal, residents of Hathi Karoda village under Babri police station limits, were heading to irrigate their fields. Near Jalalpur Cut, two motorcycle-borne men allegedly threatened them with a pistol and robbed them of a mobile phone, motorcycle keys, and ₹180. When the farmers resisted, the accused fired shots and fled the scene. The victims immediately informed the police, following which a case was registered, and search operations were launched. Police traced the suspects to the Jalalpur Cut area. Upon spotting police teams, the accused attempted to flee. After a 12-kilometre chase, they were cornered near the Khandrawali culvert. One of the suspects opened fire on the police. In retaliatory firing, Mehtab was hit by two bullets, one in the chest and one in the back, and fell on the spot. He was declared dead during treatment at the hospital, while his accomplice escaped under the cover of darkness. Police recovered the looted mobile phone, ₹180 in cash, a motorcycle without a number plate, a 9mm pistol, a 9mm carbine, 13 live cartridges, and eight spent cartridges from the spot. Wanted in over 34 cases SP NP Singh stated that Mehtab, originally from Kairana town, had been living in Saharanpur since 2017. He was involved in more than 34 cases of robbery, dacoity, murder, attempt to murder, and extortion registered in Shamli and Saharanpur districts. He was an active member of the notorious Mukim Kala gang operating in western Uttar Pradesh. Also wanted in robbery cases involving police personnel Police further said that on 1 March 2026, in the Lisadh forest area under Kotwali Shamli, cash and a mobile phone were looted from Arvind Kumar, Assistant Manager of Thanabhawan Sugar Mill. Mehtab was also wanted in another case involving the robbery of jewellery—including earrings, a nose ring, and a ring—from Haryana Police woman constable Jyoti Malik. The Saharanpur Range DIG had announced a reward of ₹50,000 for his arrest.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath hears grievances of 200 people in Gorakhpur:CM directs officials to ensure swift resolution of public complaints
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, who is on a three-day visit to Gorakhpur, heard the grievances of around 200 people during the Janta Darshan held on Friday morning, the second day of his tour. He directed officials to ensure that every public complaint is resolved promptly, emphasising that efforts should be made to settle issues at the police station and tehsil level itself. The Chief Minister stated that public grievances must be handled with sensitivity and resolved in a manner that ensures satisfaction of the complainants. He stressed that there should be no negligence in this work and assured those present that the government would address every issue raised. On Friday morning, the 'Janta Darshan' was organised at the Gorakhnath Temple, where people were seated on chairs to present their concerns. A large number of women petitioners were also present. A woman from Kushinagar complained about not being given possession of her land. The Chief Minister directed the Divisional Commissioner to ensure she receives possession immediately. Another woman raised a workplace dispute, following which the Chief Minister ordered a detailed inquiry. He personally met each petitioner, collected their applications, and handed them over to officials present on the spot, instructing them to take immediate and serious action. As usual, several people also approached the Chief Minister seeking financial assistance for medical treatment. He assured them that no one’s treatment would be halted due to lack of funds. A woman suffering from a heart ailment was assured financial support from the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund for her treatment. CM Yogi also directed officials to take swift and strict action in cases related to land encroachment, stating that those involved in illegal occupation of land must face firm consequences. Earlier in the day, the Chief Minister visited a cowshed and participated in feeding and serving the cows.

stories.title: Man dupes woman in pretext of job at AIIMS:Security guard gave fake joining letter, took ₹1.30 Lakh; accused arrested
stories.summary: A man accused of duping people by promising jobs at AIIMS Gorakhpur was arrested by police on Thursday. The accused allegedly took ₹1.30 lakh from a woman on the pretext of securing her a job as hospital attendant. To gain her trust, he allegedly provided a fake appointment letter and an AIIMS uniform. However, when the woman reached AIIMS to join duty, officials discovered that the documents were forged. The accused has been identified as Jaisingh, a resident of Ahirauli village in Sardarnagar, Chauri Chaura. He was employed as a security guard at AIIMS. Know the full story Seema Kumari, a resident of Maherwa Ki Bari in the Khorabar area, lodged an FIR on 23 October 2025 against Jaisingh and his wife, accusing them of fraud and criminal misappropriation. According to the complaint, Jaisingh lured her by promising to secure her a ward boy's job at AIIMS Gorakhpur. He allegedly took ₹1.30 lakh from her in exchange for the appointment. To convince her that the job had been arranged, he handed over an AIIMS uniform and assured her that the appointment letter would be issued within a week. This further strengthened the victim's trust. A few days later, as promised, he allegedly handed over what appeared to be an appointment letter. Fraud exposed at AIIMS After receiving the appointment letter, Seema reached AIIMS to complete the joining formalities. During document verification, hospital officials declared the appointment letter and related documents to be fake. It was only then that she realised she had been cheated. Seema also alleged that Jaisingh's wife was involved in the fraud. Since the FIR was registered, police had been investigating the case. Further action underway Superintendent of Police (City) Nimish Patil said that the investigation uncovered sufficient evidence against the accused. Based on the findings, police from AIIMS police station arrested Jaisingh on Thursday morning. Further legal action is underway.

stories.title: Ram Mandir theft case- All accused sent to judicial custody:General Secretary Champat Rai and Trustee Anil Mishra resign from their posts
stories.summary: Amid the embezzlement of temple funds of the Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Teerth Kshetra, General Secretary of the trust Champat Rai has resigned from his post. He submitted his resignation to the trust's President Mahant Nritya Gopal Das. Trustee Dr Anil Mishra has also stepped down from his post. Trustee Nripendra Misra told Dainik Bhaskar, 'I have been informed about the resignations of Champat Rai and Anil Mishra.' Earlier, eight accused, including Ramashankar Yadav alias Tinnu, a close associate of Champat Rai, were arrested late on Thursday night. All accused were presented before the CJM Court and send to judicial custody. According to KC Verma, Prosecution Officer for Ayodhya, CJM Court, says, "8 accused persons were arrested, and they have been remanded until Monday. They will be produced in court again on Monday. They have been placed in judicial custody. In total, ₹79,85,493 was recovered from them, except for one- Subhash; nothing was recovered from Subhash, though he was involved in the conspiracy. Different amounts were recovered from the others. The first FIR in the case was registered late on Thursday evening following a complaint filed by trust member Krishna Mohan. However, the FIR does not name senior office-bearers, including Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra. The alleged theft first came to light on 7 June. The Uttar Pradesh government constituted a Special Investigation Team (SIT) on 13 June. The SIT submitted its preliminary report to Additional Chief Secretary (Home) Sanjay Prasad on 23 June.

stories.title: LPG tanker crashes into Kaushambi toll plaza, explodes:Driver killed, 5 employees injured; flames visible 2 km away
stories.summary: An LPG tanker crashed into a toll plaza in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district at around 7 am on Friday before exploding and catching fire, leaving the tanker driver dead and five toll plaza employees injured. Police said the driver's body was recovered from inside the burnt vehicle and sent for post-mortem. The five injured employees, who sustained burn injuries, have been referred to SRN Hospital in Prayagraj for treatment. The explosion sent thick plumes of smoke and flames soaring into the sky, visible from nearly 2 kilometres away. The fire triggered panic at the toll plaza, with traffic coming to a halt as long queues of buses and cars built up on both sides of the highway. Massive blaze sparks panic The fire was so intense that no one dared to go near the tanker. Chaos broke out at the scene, with people screaming and rushing to safety as the flames engulfed the area. Fire brigade teams have reached the spot and are working to bring the blaze under control. The accident occurred at Sihori Toll Plaza in the Kokhraj police station area, around 16 kilometres from the Kaushambi district headquarters. See pictures of the accident- Here's how the incident unfolded Eyewitnesses said the LPG tanker was travelling from Kanpur to Pratapgarh when the accident occurred. According to them, the crash happened while the driver was attempting to overtake another vehicle. The tanker was reportedly travelling at around 60–70 kmph when it struck the central divider and overturned. The driver and conductor jumped out of the vehicle and fled the scene immediately after the crash. Gas leak triggered explosion and fire Superintendent of Police (SP) Satyanarayan Prajapat said preliminary information from toll plaza staff suggests that the tanker began leaking gas after the collision. The gas leak was followed by a powerful explosion, which sparked a massive fire. He added that the District Supply Officer (DSO) and a technical team have been informed and will investigate the exact cause of the incident. 16 motorcycles and 2 cars destroyed in fire at Toll Plaza yard Toll plaza employee Sanjay Nirmal said light rain had fallen around 10 minutes before the accident. "We don't know what suddenly happened. The entire tanker crashed with a loud bang, after which gas started leaking. Moments later, a massive fire broke out," he said. The flames quickly spread to the toll plaza's adjoining vehicle yard and nearby toilet block. More than 16 motorcycles and two cars parked in the yard were completely gutted. The parking area is used by toll plaza staff to keep their vehicles. Supervisor Alok Pandey, who was inside the toilet block at the time of the fire, also sustained severe burn injuries. Seven injured, 5 referred to Prayagraj SP Prajapat said seven people were injured in the accident. Five victims received initial treatment at the district hospital but were later referred to Prayagraj after their condition was found to be critical. The remaining two people sustained minor injuries and were discharged after receiving first aid. SP Satyanarayan Prajapat said- As soon as we received information about the fire near Kokhraj Toll Plaza, all fire brigade vehicles in the district and civil police personnel were immediately dispatched to the spot. Traffic was halted as a safety precaution. The fire brigade has now brought the blaze completely under control, and traffic is being restored gradually.

stories.title: From former MPs to doctors balancing politics:Who are the 13 women in UP BJP's new team?
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) announced its new state organisational team on 25 June, giving significant representation to women. In the backdrop of the political discourse surrounding women's representation, the party has appointed 13 influential women leaders to its new executive committee, including the State President of the BJP Mahila Morcha. The new team includes former Members of Parliament, grassroots political workers and professionals who have balanced successful careers with public service. The BJP has also carefully considered social engineering while selecting these women leaders. Of the 13 appointees, four belong to the General category, six to the Other Backward Classes (OBC), and three to the Scheduled Caste category. Here is a closer look at the women leaders the BJP is banking on as it seeks to counter the Samajwadi Party's PDA narrative ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Priyanka Rawat broke down after losing her parliamentary ticket Priyanka Rawat's parents are residents of Bareilly, while she married Raghunath Rawat of Barabanki. Having been active in student politics, she joined the BJP in 2013. At just 28 years of age, she was fielded by the BJP from the Barabanki Lok Sabha constituency in the 2014 General Election. She defeated senior Congress leader P.L. Punia by a margin of 2.11 lakh votes. Ahead of the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, however, the BJP replaced her with Upendra Rawat as its candidate. The decision left Priyanka visibly emotional, and she publicly broke down in tears. She later served as State General Secretary in the organisational team led by Swatantra Dev Singh. In the newly constituted team under State President Pankaj Chaudhary, she has now been appointed State Vice-President. Fluent in English and regarded as an effective communicator, Priyanka Rawat is considered to enjoy strong support among Dalit communities. Raised in the discipline of the Sangh Archana Mishra's father, C.P. Mishra, worked in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. Owing to her family's long association with the Sangh, she became associated with the Rashtriya Sevika Samiti, the women's wing of the Sangh, from a young age. Her husband, Sanjay Tripathi, is also associated with the Sangh and runs his own business. Archana has served as President of the Bakshi Ka Talab (BKT) Mandal. She has also worked extensively in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's parliamentary constituency of Varanasi, where she remained actively engaged with women during election campaigns despite the scorching summer heat. She has served as the convenor of the Ujjwala Yojana and has also held charge as the district in-charge of Barabanki. She is currently responsible for organisational work in Unnao district. SP came under attack after she praised Yogi Pooja Pal, who belongs to the Extremely Backward Pal community, entered politics following the murder of her husband, Raju Pal. She initially lost the by-election but registered her first electoral victory in 2007, defeating Ashraf, the brother of gangster-turned-politician Atiq Ahmed, while contesting on a Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) ticket. She retained her seat in the 2012 Assembly elections. She later joined the Samajwadi Party and won the Chail Assembly seat in Kaushambi on an SP ticket in the 2022 Assembly elections. During the Rajya Sabha elections held in February 2024, Pooja Pal cross-voted in favour of the BJP candidate, defying the Samajwadi Party's official stand. Later, during an Assembly session, she openly praised Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for the government's action against the mafia. Following her rebellion, the Samajwadi Party expelled her. The BJP has now inducted her into its organisation by appointing her as a State Vice-President in the newly announced executive. Built a political career alongside her medical profession Dr Kirtika Agrawal is a renowned laparoscopic surgeon based in Prayagraj. Her husband, Dr Neeraj Agrawal, is also a General and Laparoscopic Surgeon. Her father, Girdhar Das, was associated with the Sangh for many years. Because of this family background, she became involved with the Sangh and its affiliated organisations from an early age. Alongside her medical profession, she has remained active in social work. During the Mahakumbh and the annual Magh Mela in Prayagraj, she organised free medical treatment camps and community meals. She also runs a gaushala (cow shelter) and practises organic farming. During the 2017 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, when then-BJP National President Amit Shah held his landmark roadshow in Prayagraj, Dr Agrawal served as the chief convenor for the event. From village head to Rajya Sabha MP, now State General Secretary Geeta Shakya, who belongs to the OBC community, is widely known in her region as 'Geeta alias Chandraprabha Shakya'. Her maternal home is in Hamirpur, while she is married to Mukut Singh Shakya of Auraiya. She began her professional career as a teacher and served as a headmistress between 2005 and 2010. Her husband has also worked as a teacher. The couple have two children—a son serving in the Border Security Force (BSF) and a married daughter. Geeta Shakya entered public life in 2000 after being elected Gram Pradhan (village head) of Situaapur village. She later joined the BJP. In 2021, she was appointed State President of the BJP Mahila Morcha and subsequently served as a Rajya Sabha MP. Recognising her organisational abilities, the party has now entrusted her with the important responsibility of State General Secretary in the new team led by Pankaj Chaudhary. From student politics to the State Working Committee Rajni Pandey, who has been appointed State Minister in the BJP's new Uttar Pradesh executive, began her political journey through the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) during her student years. Her husband works as a journalist. By appointing Rajni Pandey, who hails from Deoria district in eastern Uttar Pradesh, the BJP has sought to strengthen both women's representation and its Brahmin social equation. She has remained highly active in organisational work and has campaigned extensively for the party during elections in Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh. Over the years, she has also handled several important responsibilities in various organisational campaigns and programmes. From reality television to BJP State Minister Mahamedhaa Nagar, who belongs to the OBC Gurjar community, also began her political journey through the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad. She contested the Delhi University Students' Union election in 2017 and was elected Secretary by a comfortable margin. During her student politics days, she earned a reputation as an outspoken and assertive youth leader. After joining the BJP organisation, she became one of the party's prominent faces on television debates as the Uttar Pradesh BJP State Spokesperson, consistently presenting the party's views on various public platforms. Known as an accomplished public speaker, Mahamedhaa has represented India in eight countries. Before entering full-time politics, she appeared as a contestant on the popular reality television programme MTV Roadies in 2016 and featured in around ten episodes. She is unmarried and devotes her entire time to organisational work and politics. Carrying forward her father's political legacy Akanksha belongs to the Dalit Sonkar community. Her father, the late Dinesh Chandra Sonkar, was a BJP MLA. She is married to SSB Commandant Amit Sonkar, who is posted in Kanpur.nFollowing her father's death in 2012, she returned from Kanpur to Prayagraj to carry forward his political legacy. She joined the BJP between 2013 and 2014 and has remained active in the Bara Assembly constituency and the Yamunapar district organisation. She attracted the attention of the party leadership by organising several large women's conferences in the region. She has also campaigned for the BJP in Delhi, Rajasthan, Gujarat, West Bengal and Haryana. Carrying her parental home's ideology into her marital home Lodhi Kiran Nishad represents two influential OBC communities, the Lodhi and the Nishad communities. Originally from Bahoriband in Katni district of Madhya Pradesh, she married Prashant Kumar Nishad of Kanpur, who is a businessman. Senior BJP leader Uma Bharti is her elder sister by relation. Her maternal family has long been associated with the BJP. Her brother has served as a Block Pramukh, while one of her sisters has been a District Panchayat member. In contrast, members of her in-laws' family were associated with the Samajwadi Party. Her paternal uncle-in-law was Babu Manohar Lal. Inspired by Uma Bharti, Kiran joined the BJP in 2008. She later became active in public awareness campaigns through the Namami Gange Vichar Manch. The party subsequently appointed her Regional Co-convener for Kanpur-Bundelkhand. Most recently, she was serving as a State Co-convener within the organisation. Rose through the ranks without a political background Sanchita Shree Chauhan belongs to the backward Lonia (Chauhan) community of Purvanchal. Her maternal home is in Sasaram, Bihar, while she is married to businessman Sanjay Singh of Lalganj in Azamgarh. She joined the BJP in 2012. Neither her maternal nor her marital family had any political background, making her the first member of her family to enter politics. She served as the convenor for the Lalganj Lok Sabha constituency during the 2019 General Election. Recalling her early struggle, she says, "During those days, organisational meetings often continued until one o'clock in the morning. Returning home so late as a woman in a remote rural area like Lalganj was frightening, but I was never afraid." Her grassroots efforts helped the BJP secure around 82,000 votes from the Lalganj Assembly segment. Recognising her dedication, the party has now appointed her as a State Minister in the Uttar Pradesh BJP. Rose through the ranks without a political 'Godfather' Deepmala Santoshi, from the Jatav Dalit community, joined the BJP in 2010 despite having no political background in either her parental or marital family. Her husband, Devendra Kumar, is a retired Indian Army officer. Initially aspiring to become a teacher, she entered politics because of her commitment to nationalism and the BJP's ideology. She has been actively involved in grassroots campaigns across western Uttar Pradesh, strengthening the party's booth-level network. She also gained organisational experience during the West Bengal, Rajasthan and Delhi Assembly elections. On her appointment, Deepmala said the BJP gives every dedicated worker an equal opportunity to grow regardless of political connections, adding that she had no "godfather" in politics. Chose BJP despite Congress roots in her Marital family Prayagraj-born Suhasini Jaiswal was influenced by the Arya Samaj values of her father, the late Om Prakash Jaiswal, and developed an early inclination towards the RSS and the BJP. After marrying businessman Sandeep Jaiswal of Bareilly's Faridpur, she joined a family where her late father-in-law, Tulsiram Jaiswal, had been an active Congress leader and Mandal President. Despite this, she remained with the BJP. She had earlier withdrawn her claim to contest the Faridpur Municipal Council chairperson's election after the party asked her to focus on organisational work. Recognising her loyalty, the BJP has now appointed her as a State Secretary in Uttar Pradesh. From a Lohiaite family to leading the BJP Mahila Morcha Saroj Kushwaha, from the influential Kushwaha community of eastern Uttar Pradesh, joined the BJP in 1992 after beginning her student politics at Samastipur College in Bihar. While her father, Ramvyas Singh, was a Lohiaite and worked in the Railways, her marital family in Ghazipur was deeply associated with the BJP. After her mother-in-law, Dr Nirmala Kushwaha, stepped away from active politics to become a college principal, Saroj took charge of the family's political responsibilities. She was denied a BJP ticket from the Zamania Assembly constituency in 2017 but continued to work in the organisation. As the party's organisational in-charge for Mirzapur, she helped secure victories in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections and the Majhwan Assembly by-election. In recognition of her performance, the BJP has appointed her as the Uttar Pradesh Mahila Morcha President.

The incident, which went viral, saw her swerve at the last moment to miss an oncoming SUV. Emily promptly apologized, admitting fault and attributing the lapse to recently disengaging her Tesla's Autopilot. This event reignites concerns about her past distracted driving incident and Twitch channel suspension.

Authorities arrived at a St. Louis residence where they discovered the infant, Kiyomi Parker, suffering from a gunshot wound. It has come to light that the young suspect accessed a firearm that was concealed under a mattress.

Icelandic proverb of the day: "No one becomes an unbeaten bishop", a lesson on how power comes with adversity, betrayal and competition

This timeless wisdom parallels the notion that greatness is forged through struggle. Today's challenges, such as online criticism, contribute to this necessary resilience, equipping leaders with the empathy and humility needed to inspire and connect authentically with others.

stories.title: Arabic proverb of the day: 'The mountain went into labor and gave birth to a mouse'
stories.summary: An age-old Arabic proverb, 'The mountain went into labor and gave birth to a mouse,' beautifully illustrates the letdown of expecting grand results from moderate efforts. This phrase, with roots in ancient Roman texts, critiques the tendency to inflate expectations, urging individuals to assess outcomes rather than illusions. Its persistent relevance serves as a powerful reminder of our vulnerability to overpromise and underdeliver in today's fast-paced world.

The duo triumphed in the Lightweight Men's Double Sculls at Lucerne, Switzerland, with a remarkable time of 6 minutes and 26.09 seconds. This move further fuels allegations of 'horse-trading' against the ruling Tamizhaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK). Vijayabhaskar is expected to join the TVK soon, following other former AIADMK members who have already switched allegiance. The opposition continues to criticize the ruling party for luring MLAs.

Rajasthan, Haryana sign pact to implement 1994 Upper Yamuna agreement, clearing way for Rs 34,102 crore water project
stories.summary: Haryana and Rajasthan have inked a crucial Memorandum of Understanding in New Delhi to operationalize the 1994 Upper Yamuna River Board Agreement. Presided over by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, the pact aims to streamline the sharing and management of Yamuna river waters between the two states. This significant step brings a decades-old water-sharing pact closer to full implementation.

stories.title: '9 years, female, white, virgin': Why Harry Potter, Hello Kitty toys in Europe are being probed for child trafficking
Suhrawardy’s many afterlives: From Direct Action Day to Jordan’s royal family
stories.summary: The row over Kolkata’s Suhrawardy Avenue opens a wider story of memory, guilt and legacy. Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy remains tied to Bengal famine, Direct Action Day and Partition. Yet his family’s afterlives stretch across scholarship, diplomacy, human rights, Pakistan’s politics, Bangladesh’s public life and Jordan’s royalty over two turbulent centuries.

Who is Amanda Nguyen: Meet the rape survivor who became the first Vietnamese woman in space on Blue Origin's historic mission

stories.summary: DMK leaders MK Stalin and Udhayanidhi Stalin have launched a sharp critique against the ruling TVK government, citing administrative failures, a decline in law and order, and the Tamil Nadu Assembly's transformation into a "film shooting spot." They allege the government is struggling to address power cuts, water shortages, and rising crime, while accusing the Chief Minister of prioritizing optics over governance.

Following days of military exchanges, both nations will halt counter-strikes, allowing vessels to navigate freely. The discussions aim to resolve differing interpretations of a recent memorandum of understanding concerning maritime passage and port access.

‘A man does not die alone’: Chilling messages left by Bangladeshi man before killing family
stories.summary: A haunting social media message has surfaced in connection with a horrific triple homicide in Rome, where a father, mother, and their young daughter were discovered lifeless. The primary suspect, 43-year-old Shahadat Hossain from Bangladesh, is the focus of an extensive manhunt by the police. His ominous post, stating, 'A man does not die alone,' is now pivotal to the ongoing investigation.

Korean proverb of the day: 'When whales fight, the shrimp’s back gets broken'
stories.summary: A centuries-old Korean proverb, "When whales fight, the shrimp's back gets broken," vividly illustrates how the powerless suffer during conflicts between the influential. This timeless wisdom, originating from oral tradition, remains strikingly relevant today, applying to everything from international relations and corporate disputes to family struggles. Its enduring power lies in its simple yet potent imagery, reminding us that even seemingly distant battles have far-reaching consequences for the vulnerable.

31-year-old Pakistani national held after crossing LoC in Poonch
stories.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Police apprehended a 31-year-old Pakistani national, Rayees Khan, on Sunday after he allegedly crossed the Line of Control into Indian territory in the Balakote sector. No incriminating material was found. This marks the third such apprehension this month, following the capture of another Pakistani national, Mohd Sajad, on Friday near the LoC in Poonch. Both individuals are currently being questioned to determine their motives and backgrounds.

stories.title: Filipino proverb of the day: 'A desperate person clings even to a knife'
stories.summary: The Filipino saying, "A desperate person clings even to a knife," powerfully conveys how dire situations can lead individuals to make perilous decisions, often feeling trapped with no alternatives. This age-old wisdom, rooted in oral tradition, seeks to explain rather than condemn, revealing our innate tendency to prioritize survival in the face of adversity. Its lasting significance calls for compassion and a deeper understanding of challenging scenarios.

stories.title: CBSE cites 11-mark rise to rebut student’s re-eval charge; 99.7% Class XII re-eval cases cleared
stories.summary: CBSE has finalized verification and re-evaluation for over 99.7% of Class XII 2026 result applications, refuting a student's social media claims of minimal mark increases as false. The Board detailed a student's actual mark jump of 11 points, including a significant nine-mark rise in Physics. This clarification addresses concerns surrounding the new on-screen marking system, with CBSE assuring that all necessary checks were performed.

Assam Rifles, Indian Navy band to join Seychelles' Golden Jubilee Independence Day celebrations
stories.summary: India's commitment to Seychelles' security and prosperity was underscored during the island nation's 50th Independence Day celebrations. Prime Minister Modi, the guest of honour, highlighted the indivisible nature of regional security and gifted a fast patrol vessel, LESPWAR, along with other defence equipment. An Assam Rifles contingent and an Indian Navy band participated, with two naval ships docked at Port Victoria, reinforcing decades of unwavering friendship and solidarity.

stories.title: California teacher marries Gaza man to give him US citizenship; attorney calls it 'foolish'
stories.summary: In a bold move, a dance instructor from California has wed a man from Gaza through a virtual ceremony, aiming to support his US citizenship aspirations and advocate for Palestinian rights. This unconventional union has raised eyebrows among immigration specialists, who caution about the risks of marriage fraud allegations. Meanwhile, she passionately encourages her students to engage in pro-Palestinian issues and activism.

'Babur Janata Party': Uddhav Thackeray attacks BJP over Ram Mandir donation row
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray slammed the BJP over alleged Ram Mandir donation irregularities, dubbing them the "Babur Janata Party" and accusing them of exploiting faith for political power. He also alleged the BJP is weakening Shiv Sena to undermine. Referring to BJP's long-standing slogan, he questioned the party's intentions behind the construction of the Ram temple.

stories.title: 'Disqualify six rebel MPs': Uddhav links defections to 'Operation Devendra'
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray demanded the disqualification of six rebel MPs, calling their defection a "larger political conspiracy" and part of "Operation Devendra." He urged Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla to uphold the rule of law, alleging the BJP is undermining its own leaders. Thackeray, on a tour of rebel MPs' constituencies, asserted that people voted against the "Modi wave," not for the defectors.

Elon Musk says Jeff Bezos’ ex-wife MacKenzie Scott giving $26.3 billion to charity is...
stories.summary: In a surprising turn, tech titan Elon Musk has criticized the remarkable philanthropic contributions of MacKenzie Scott, arguing that her vast donations could have negative impacts on society. Scott, the former wife of Jeff Bezos, has pledged to donate the majority of her wealth, over $26 billion, to various charitable organizations. Musk's controversial remarks, including a now-deleted tweet that associated wealthy ex-spouses with societal decline, have ignited intense discussions online.

stories.title: Amritsar to get grand temple dedicated to Mata Sita, Luv-Kush: Kejriwal

Despite a reported decline in overall numbers, the reality for women and children remains grim, exacerbated by systemic issues in law enforcement and the judiciary. The Supreme Court's new 'Victim Protection Plan' aims to address these critical gaps, offering a glimmer of hope for those seeking safety and rehabilitation.

stories.title: 'Pressured to recite religious verses, eat beef': Kanpur teen alleges abduction, confinement to force conversion; one arrested
‘Indian H1-B holders are…’: Immigration lawyer says waiting on green cards for years is...
stories.summary: Amidst shifting US immigration policies and prolonged green card delays, many Indian engineers and researchers on H-1B visas are now considering the UK's Global Talent Visa as a viable alternative. This visa enables skilled individuals to swiftly achieve settlement in the UK and work independently, eliminating the need for employer backing, thus presenting a compelling option alongside their dreams of success in the United States.

'Sentiments hurt': Ayodhya lawyers refuse to defend Ram temple donation case accused
stories.summary: Eight individuals accused in the Ayodhya Ram Temple donation case face a significant hurdle as local lawyers have unanimously agreed not to represent them. The Faizabad Bar Association is set to formalize this decision, citing hurt sentiments over the alleged theft of temple offerings. Meanwhile, police conducted raids on the accused's residences, with investigators having recovered nearly Rs 80 lakh.

Odisha: Four minors attack catering staff for not serving mutton curry at wedding feast
stories.summary: Four teenagers were arrested in Odisha's Balasore district for allegedly assaulting a catering staff member. The incident occurred at a wedding feast when the victim reportedly refused to serve mutton, offering chicken instead. The dispute escalated, leading to the minors allegedly attacking the caterer with a sharp weapon, causing severe injuries.

Kerala government orders probe after protocol lapse causes Vijayan to miss flight
stories.summary: Kerala's opposition leader, Pinarayi Vijayan, missed his flight from Delhi to Kerala due to a protocol lapse. Officials failed to confirm travel plans with the airline, despite Vijayan reaching the airport well in advance. An inquiry has been ordered, with disciplinary action promised against the responsible protocol staff. Vijayan eventually travelled to Kannur on a later flight.

stories.title: Elon Musk sparks row after posting banned 'anti-immigrant' film on X
stories.summary: The X platform, helmed by Elon Musk, recently showcased Armie Hammer's contentious film 'Citizen Vigilante,' which faced a ban in Germany due to its inflammatory themes against immigrants. Following Musk's endorsement, the film surged in popularity on Apple TV, despite mixed reviews. Now, a sequel is in the works, signaling Hammer's return to the spotlight after he faced serious allegations, which he staunchly denies.

'Indian Ocean connects us, not separates us': Top quotes from PM Modi's Seychelles Parliament address
Three Indian-origin men jailed in London for running £174,000 drugs network
stories.summary: In a significant crackdown, authorities have dismantled a large drug trafficking operation in London, orchestrated by incarcerated dealer Hardeep Thind. Three men of Indian descent, including an active magistrate, received prison sentences for their involvement in distributing cocaine and heroin worth £174,000. Following Thind's release, the illegal network expanded, prompting police to conduct thorough investigations, resulting in numerous arrests and convictions.

stories.title: Geo News off air for 15 days after Pakistan suspends licence over Muharram show
stories.summary: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) said the channel broadcast "religious visualisations" during its June 26 transmission, adding that the material had the potential to offend viewers, undermine religious harmony and create law and order concerns during one of the holiest and most sensitive periods in the Islamic calendar.
